chat.title: Ask about your records
suggestedQuestions: Can I buy headphones for 150,000 MMK and last the month?
Which expense category is eating my money?
chat.weeklyIncomeAnswer: Your recorded income clocked in at {{amount}} MMK this week ({{startDate}} to {{endDate}}). Let it settle in before your shopping cart starts assigning it jobs.
chat.weeklyExpensesAnswer: Your wallet has been doing cardio: {{amount}} MMK in recorded expenses this week ({{startDate}} to {{endDate}}). Check the receipts below before declaring it all 'essential'.
chat.weeklyCategoryAnswer: This week ({{startDate}} to {{endDate}}), your highest expense category is {{category}} at {{amount}} MMK.
chat.noWeeklyTransactionsAnswer: There are no settled expenses this week ({{startDate}} to {{endDate}}).
chat.noWeeklyIncomeAnswer: There is no settled income this week ({{startDate}} to {{endDate}}).
chat.receivablesAnswer: {{amount}} MMK across {{count}} unpaid receivable(s). Your invoices are out there living their best lives while you wait. A polite payment reminder beats spending money that hasn't arrived.
chat.description: Playful financial roasts grounded in your recorded activity.
chat.limits: Scripted roasts using this workspace's records, not live AI. Purchase checks compare monthly cash movement; they don't know your cash balance or all upcoming bills. We roast spending choices, not your worth.
chat.questionPlaceholder: Can I buy headphones for 150k MMK? Be honest.
chat.unsupportedAnswer: My demo brain has a smaller budget than your shopping cart. Try a purchase price in MMK, 'roast my spending', your biggest expense category, or unpaid receivables. I can't predict loan approval or future balances, or give investment, legal, or tax advice.
chat.purchasePriceNeeded: The shopping cart is ready, but the price tag skipped the meeting. Give me one price, like 'Can I buy headphones for 150,000 MMK?' I'll compare it with this month's recorded cash movement. I can't promise it'll carry you through month-end.
chat.purchaseOverNet: Your shopping cart just applied for a budget it hasn't been offered. This month you've recorded {{income}} MMK coming in and {{expenses}} MMK going out: net movement of {{net}} MMK. That {{price}} MMK purchase exceeds that net, taking the comparison to {{after}} MMK. That's cash-flow math, not your bank balance. Check cash on hand and essential bills before buying; these records can't confirm you'll make it through the month.
chat.purchaseWithinNet: The math hasn't called security, but your cart is getting comfortable. Recorded income is {{income}} MMK and expenses are {{expenses}} MMK this month, giving {{net}} MMK in net movement. Subtract that {{price}} MMK purchase and the comparison is {{after}} MMK. That's not cash available or a month-end guarantee. Check cash on hand and upcoming essentials before giving the headphones a home.
chat.documentsAnswer: You marked {{completed}} of {{total}} supporting document checklist items as available.
chat.overdueAnswer: {{count}} unpaid item(s) are overdue, totaling {{amount}} MMK.
chat.outstandingAnswer: You have {{receivable}} MMK in unpaid incoming payments and {{payable}} MMK in unpaid obligations.
chat.topExpenseAnswer: {{amount}} MMK: your biggest recorded expense this month entered the chat with main-character energy. The record below tells you what earned that title.
chat.categoryAnswer: {{category}} is leading the spending leaderboard at {{amount}} MMK this month. Congratulations to the category; condolences to the budget. Check what's essential before trimming it.
chat.periodAnswer: Your money has a plot: {{income}} MMK in, {{expenses}} MMK out, and {{net}} MMK in net movement this month. Your next impulse purchase doesn't need a starring role. These are settled records, not your current cash balance; check the receipts before blaming 'little purchases'.
chat.noTransactionsAnswer: No matching settled records this month. I can't roast receipts that haven't shown up. Add your income and expenses first; an empty log isn't proof that you can afford it.

readiness.title: Credit readiness
readiness.description: Choose a bank to see how your existing records match its example requirements.
readiness.disclaimer: These bank requirements are user-provided examples and have not been confirmed by the lenders. FlowScore is an app-only cash-flow indicator, not a bank score, creditworthiness assessment, or loan approval prediction.
readiness.chooseBankHelp: Select one of the example bank profiles to review its checklist.
readiness.monthCoverage: Settled records currently cover {{months}} of 12 months.
readiness.selfReportedHelp: Checked documents are self-reported. No document files are uploaded or stored.
readiness.flowScoreHelp: A transparent cash-flow indicator based on your last 12 months of settled records. It is not a bank score, creditworthiness assessment, or approval likelihood.
readiness.scoreNeedsMonths: FlowScore needs 6 active months ({{active}}/6); only history coverage is shown until then.
readiness.receiptCoverage: Receipt evidence: {{reviewed}} reviewed of {{total}} settled receipt or screenshot records.
readiness.summaryCoverage: {{active}} of 12 months contain settled records - {{count}} records
readiness.reportHelp: The one-page PDF contains a transaction summary, checklist, record coverage, and limitations. It does not include original receipt images.
